decisions: Part 30-batch2: acts chosen for their weight in practice among the ZimLII acts whose current expression, and every earlier expression ZimLII lists, could be read with its text, and whose newest page lists no amendment ZimLII has not yet applied. Acts that ZimLII still carries only at the Law Development Commission's consolidation as at 31 December 2016 were left out, even where its page shows no later amendment: several such acts have successors made after 2016 that ZimLII also publishes (for example the Marriage Act and the Marriages Act, 2022, or the Insolvency Act and the Insolvency Act, 2018), so a 2016 text cannot be taken as today's law without a check this part does not make. This part takes acts made from 2018 onwards, as ZimLII publishes them, and older acts whose newest ZimLII version is from 2024 or later.
The acts in this part name ZimLII as their own publisher: the country publisher is Veritas, the source of the Constitution.
The Persons with Disabilities Act, 2025 is left out: ZimLII marks it "Not commenced".
ai_use: Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5, claude-opus-5-5) wrote the configuration and wrappers and chose the acts; the shared Peachjam adapter does the parsing. No model wrote, summarised or transformed legal text.
